summary: Sets the playback volume on a Bink video object. Only updates when the new volume a2 differs from the stored float at this+0x10 and lies within the range bounded by the two stored double constants dbl_59E430 and dbl_59E420. The accepted value is stored back at this+0x10, scaled by the constant dbl_5B8990, truncated to an integer via CRTFtol, and passed to BinkSetVolume together with the Bink handle at this+0x0.

operations.description: If the stored volume at this+0x10 already equals a2, or a2 falls outside the range bounded by dbl_59E430 and dbl_59E420, skip the update.
Store a2 into this+0x10 as the current volume.
Scale the volume by dbl_5B8990 and truncate to an integer via CRTFtol.
Call BinkSetVolume with the Bink handle at this+0x0, channel 0, and the scaled volume integer.
